summary.zh: 点一下复制：图标换成一笔画出来的勾，文字上下替换，按钮宽度顺滑地变长、变绿，过两秒自己还原。本站的「复制 Prompt」就是它。
summary.en: Click to copy: the icon swaps to a hand-drawn tick, the label rolls to the new text, the button smoothly widens and turns green, then reverts. The site’s own Copy Prompt button.

technique.zh: 宽度动画是关键：先量出两段文字的 scrollWidth，用 WAAPI 在 width 之间过渡；勾用 stroke-dashoffset 画出来；文字两行叠在一起 translateY(-100%) 切换。
technique.en: The width is the trick: measure both labels’ scrollWidth and animate width with WAAPI; the tick draws via stroke-dashoffset; the two labels are stacked and switched with translateY(-100%).

adapt.zh: 要复制的内容放在 data-text 上，或者改 copy() 里的 writeText。
adapt.en: Put the text to copy in data-text, or change writeText in copy().
